title: Quota & Usage Cross-Provider Contract Tests

contract_rules.raw_units: raw values are preserved exactly as reported; bytes and count units must be whole numbers and negatives are rejected
contract_rules.display_units: display strings are derived only from raw_units: binary units for bytes, at most one decimal for percent bounded 0-100, whole numbers for counts; no precision beyond the raw value is ever shown
contract_rules.freshness: every record carries observed_at; age is measured against as_of and missing or future observation timestamps fail closed
contract_rules.unavailable: a null raw value classifies as unavailable, is never treated as zero, and never renders a number
contract_rules.partial_total: totals aggregate valid raw values per unit kind and are flagged partial when any record in the group is unavailable; require_complete turns an unavailable record into a failure
contract_rules.stale_warning: an observation older than fresh_ttl_seconds is classified stale, listed in stale_warning_ids, and fails certification
contract_rules.no_mock_values: records claiming a live source must carry an evidence_ref, unknown sources are rejected, and the manifest contains no secret, api_key, password, or webhook_url

limitations: records are synthetic local fixtures; no live provider quota or usage endpoint was queried
live provider quota and usage payloads, rate-limit headers, reset schedules, billing-cycle alignment, overage handling, and per-model metering remain externally deferred
hosted CI, credentials, audit trail, billing settlement, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL
no production secret, API key, or webhook endpoint is present in this manifest
